title: The Sea Motif in Early Twentieth-Century Chinese Poetry
subtitle: A comparative study of corpus, edition, and interpretation
research_question: How does the sea motif shift from symbol of exile to symbol of modernity between 1910 and 1935?
scope_definition: Chinese-language poetry published 1910-1935, excluding translated foreign verse
corpus_summary: Twelve poets across three anthologies, using the 1985 scholarly edition as control text
methodology: Close reading with comparative analysis; locators by page and line of the control edition
